observed_problem.mechanism: Trigger-6 objective claims are immutable create-only files committed through the GitHub Contents API onto one hot main branch.
observed_problem.negative_result: Two nonoverlapping claim attempts observed HTTP 409 because main moved between compare-and-swap attempts; no claim-path collision was observed.

primary_source_findings.finding: GitHub GraphQL updateRefs performs a list of ref updates atomically; RefUpdate.beforeOid can be all-zero to require that a ref does not already exist; RefUpdate.name is a fully-qualified ref name.
primary_source_findings.relevance: A per-objective ref can encode the create-only mutex without committing a file to hot main.

primary_source_findings.finding: GitHub exposes create-reference directly against the Git ref database and returns Created/Conflict/Validation outcomes.
primary_source_findings.relevance: Single-ref create is a simpler fallback when GraphQL updateRefs is unavailable.

primary_source_findings.finding: git push --force-with-lease=<ref>:<expect> supports an empty expected value meaning the remote ref must not already exist; --atomic provides all-or-none multi-ref update when supported by the server.
primary_source_findings.relevance: Native Git transport provides a dependency-light fallback with explicit nonexistence lease semantics.

primary_source_findings.finding: GitHub documents conflict behavior for concurrent mutative repository-content operations and recommends serializing concurrent REST mutations in API best practices.
primary_source_findings.relevance: This is consistent with observed hot-main contention and argues against using main-commit creation as the mutex primitive under high fan-out.

distilled_design_hypothesis.name: OBJECTIVE_REF_SEMAPHORE_V2
distilled_design_hypothesis.preferred_acquire: GraphQL updateRefs with name=<objective-ref>, beforeOid=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, afterOid=<bound F2 commit>, force=false
distilled_design_hypothesis.success: Ref created => worker owns only that objective.
distilled_design_hypothesis.duplicate: Nonexistence precondition fails => consume existing result; do not duplicate.
distilled_design_hypothesis.materialization: After acquisition, write the existing immutable claim JSON and result receipts to main as audit/provenance materialization; main materialization is not the mutex and may be retried/reconciled.
distilled_design_hypothesis.authority_boundary: The ref is coordination metadata only. pending_research.sqlite remains Trigger-6 research authority and UnifiedDB remains Frankenstein canonical state authority.
distilled_design_hypothesis.expiry_policy: No lock expiry for evidence objectives; objective ownership is create-once. Architecture-triggered re-review uses a new semantic key/objective rather than recycling the ref.

fallbacks_ranked: REST createRef for one objective ref
git push with explicit empty force-with-lease expectation against the objective ref
bounded re-entry retry on current file-claim protocol only as compatibility fallback
rejected_or_deferred: Redis/etcd/ZooKeeper distributed-lock dependencies: add infrastructure and a competing coordination store for a problem Git already models as refs.
GitHub Issues as mutex: semantic uniqueness is weak and prior issue-trigger fan-out already produced stampede behavior.
GitHub Actions concurrency as primary mutex: private Actions admission is currently a separate blocker and it couples research ownership to workflow execution.
last-writer-wins claim files: violates fail-closed duplicate prevention.
counterhypothesis: The observed 409s are transient and bounded retry is sufficient; per-objective refs would add cleanup/discoverability complexity without materially improving acquisition success.
next_falsifier: E3 no-effect coordination fixture: under controlled fan-out, compare N independent objective acquisitions plus one deliberate duplicate using current Contents-API file claims versus per-objective ref creation. Measure acquisition success, p50/p95 latency, API calls/retries, duplicate exclusion, main-head writes and stale-artifact reconciliation. No provider/model/VPS/effect execution is needed.
